integrity.claim_scope: Source-specific falsification of Theorem 2.1 plus an exact universal replacement criterion.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit Hilbert-space block operator construction and exact operator inequalities; no finite experiment is used as proof.

scientific_limitations: The exact criterion is for universal preservation of all continuous K-g-frames under right composition by U* and assumes UK=KU.
The sufficient inclusion R(K*) subset R(U) is stronger than the exact criterion and is stated only to recover the source pseudoinverse bound.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal note could contain the same source-specific correction.
title: Kernel separation is not enough for continuous \(K\)-\(g\)-frame transport
